_note: Chapter 07 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: We talked about the final exam for a whole hour.
ex.cn: 我们就期末考试聊了整整一个小时。
ex.note: a talk about 关于…的谈话；about halfway 到一半左右

ex.en: The children ran about in the grass while the rain fell.
ex.cn: 下雨的时候，孩子们在草地上到处跑。
ex.note: here and there 到处；about a third 约三分之一

ex.en: Dust had accumulated on the shelves over the summer.
ex.cn: 整个夏天，灰尘在书架上积了起来。
ex.note: accumulate to 积攒到；accumulate wealth 积累财富

ex.en: We need adequate time to finish the experiment.
ex.cn: 我们需要充足的时间来完成这项实验。
ex.note: adequate for 足以应付；be adequate to do 足以做

ex.en: They voted against the plan because it was too expensive.
ex.cn: 他们投票反对这个方案，因为它太贵了。
ex.note: against = 反对/倚靠/防备；up against 面临；be against sb. 反对某人

ex.en: She read the passage aloud so that everyone could follow.
ex.cn: 她把这段课文大声读了出来，好让每个人都跟得上。
ex.note: read aloud 大声朗读；think aloud 边想边说

ex.en: He shut the door quietly so that nobody would see his anger.
ex.cn: 他轻轻关上门，好让别人看不见他的怒气。
ex.note: in anger 愤怒地；anger at 对…的愤怒

ex.en: The careless remark angered her more than she expected.
ex.cn: 那句随口的话激怒了她，比她预想的还要厉害。
ex.note: anger sb. 使某人生气；be angered at 因…而生气

ex.en: The old library has an appeal that no new building can match.
ex.cn: 这座老图书馆有一种新楼无法比拟的魅力。
ex.note: appeal to 对…有吸引力；appeal to sb. for sth. 向某人呼吁…；on appeal 上诉

ex.en: She broke her left arm in a fall.
ex.cn: 她摔倒时摔断了左臂。
ex.note: arm in arm 手挽手；the arm of a chair 椅子扶手

ex.en: The navy was armed with two small ships.
ex.cn: 那支海军装备了两艘小船。
ex.note: arm oneself 自备武器；armed to the teeth 武装到牙齿

ex.en: She works as a teaching assistant in the chemistry department.
ex.cn: 她在化学系做教学助理。
ex.note: an assistant to sb. 某人的助理；personal assistant 私人助理

ex.en: An assistant coach helped the players warm up.
ex.cn: 一名助理教练帮球员们热身。
ex.note: assistant director 副主任；assistant manager 副经理

ex.en: The author of the book spent ten years collecting the material.
ex.cn: 这本书的作者花了十年收集素材。
ex.note: the author of … …的作者

ex.en: From the balcony of the hall he could see the whole harbour.
ex.cn: 从礼堂的楼座上望出去，整个港口尽收眼底。
ex.note: balcony seat 楼座座位；on the balcony 在阳台上

ex.en: She bathed her feet in the warm water and felt better.
ex.cn: 她把双脚泡在温水里，感觉好多了。
ex.note: bathe in 浸泡于；bathe sb. 给某人洗澡

ex.en: The bus was stuck behind a slow lorry for half an hour.
ex.cn: 公交车被一辆慢吞吞的卡车堵在后面，停了半个小时。
ex.note: behind schedule 晚点；fall behind 落后

ex.en: Biology is the subject she understands best.
ex.cn: 生物学是她最擅长的科目。
ex.note: a biology class 生物课；biology teacher 生物老师

ex.en: The human body feels warmer in the afternoon than at night.
ex.cn: 人的身体在下午比夜里更暖和一些。
ex.note: body language 肢体语言；a dead body 尸体

ex.en: The brakes on this old car are not very reliable.
ex.cn: 这辆旧车的刹车不太可靠。
ex.note: put on the brakes 刹车；brake light 刹车灯

ex.en: The driver braked hard when a dog ran across the road.
ex.cn: 一条狗横穿马路，司机猛地踩了刹车。
ex.note: brake for 刹车让行

ex.en: The two teams built a bridge across the river in ten days.
ex.cn: 两个团队在十天内建起了一座横跨河流的桥。
ex.note: build on 以…为基础；build up 逐步增强

ex.en: She bought a chocolate cake for the birthday party.
ex.cn: 她为生日聚会买了一个巧克力蛋糕。
ex.note: a piece of cake 一块蛋糕；have your cake and eat it 两者兼得

ex.en: Be careful with these cups; they are made of glass.
ex.cn: 小心这些杯子，它们是玻璃的。
ex.note: be careful to do 小心做；be careful about 对…谨慎

ex.en: The dinner was held as a celebration of her birthday.
ex.cn: 这顿晚餐是为庆祝她生日而举行的。
ex.note: in celebration of 为庆祝…；a celebration of … …的庆祝活动

ex.en: The quiet charm of the old town wins visitors over.
ex.cn: 老城那份安静的魅力俘虏了来访者。
ex.note: the charm of … …的魅力；a charm bracelet 串式手链

ex.en: The guide charmed every visitor with his stories.
ex.cn: 那位导游用他的故事迷住了每一位游客。
ex.note: charm sb. with sth. 用某物迷住某人

ex.en: He choked on a peanut and had to be tapped on the back.
ex.cn: 他被花生呛住了，得有人在他背上拍几下。
ex.note: choke on 噎住；choke back 强忍眼泪

ex.en: The windows were clean and the room smelled of soap.
ex.cn: 窗户很干净，房间里有一股肥皂味。
ex.note: a clean record 清白的记录；clean air 清洁的空气

ex.en: We cleaned the classroom before the visitors arrived.
ex.cn: 参观者到来之前，我们把教室打扫干净了。
ex.note: clean up 收拾干净；clean out 清理

ex.en: The two departments collaborated on a study of air quality.
ex.cn: 两个系合作开展了一项空气质量研究。
ex.note: collaborate with sb. on sth. 与某人合作做某事

ex.en: It is common for students to complain about the food.
ex.cn: 学生抱怨饭菜是常有的事。
ex.note: common sense 常识；be common to 普遍适用于

ex.en: Both sides finally reached a compromise after hours of talk.
ex.cn: 谈了几个小时之后，双方终于达成了妥协。
ex.note: reach/make a compromise 达成妥协；a compromise with 与…的妥协

ex.en: The scandal compromised the reputation of the whole school.
ex.cn: 这场丑闻损害了整所学校的声誉。
ex.note: compromise one's reputation 损害某人的名誉

ex.en: Her colleagues congratulated her on the first prize.
ex.cn: 同事们祝贺她获得一等奖。
ex.note: congratulate sb. on sth. 祝贺某人某事

ex.en: Please leave a contact address so that we can write to you.
ex.cn: 请留下一个联系地址，我们好写信给你。
ex.note: in contact with 与…有联系；contact lens 隐形眼镜

ex.en: If you lose your key, please contact the office immediately.
ex.cn: 如果你把钥匙丢了，请立刻联系办公室。
ex.note: contact sb. about sth. 就某事联系某人

ex.en: A good project manager coordinates the work of ten teams.
ex.cn: 好的项目经理能协调十支队伍的工作。
ex.note: coordinate with 与…协调

ex.en: Write the x and y coordinates of each point on the map.
ex.cn: 把地图上每个点的横纵坐标写出来。
ex.note: coordinate system 坐标系

ex.en: A couple of hours of sleep is not enough for a long day.
ex.cn: 睡上两三个小时，对漫长的一天来说是不够的。
ex.note: a couple of 几个；a young couple 一对年轻夫妇

ex.en: The book received a great deal of criticism from readers.
ex.cn: 这本书受到读者们大量的批评。
ex.note: criticism of 对…的批评；a criticism of 批评意见

ex.en: She put a small cushion under her elbow.
ex.cn: 她在胳膊肘下垫了一个小垫子。
ex.note: cushion the blow 缓冲打击

ex.en: He knows a great deal about the history of the town.
ex.cn: 他对这个镇子的历史知道得很多。
ex.note: a great deal of 大量；a good deal 相当多；a business deal 生意

ex.en: We must deal with this problem before the term ends.
ex.cn: 我们必须在学期结束前处理这个问题。
ex.note: deal with 处理；deal in 经营

ex.en: We need a definite answer before Friday.
ex.cn: 我们需要一个明确的答复，哪怕只要周五之前给。
ex.note: definite article 定冠词；a definite plan 明确的计划

ex.en: The plane began to descend through the thick cloud.
ex.cn: 飞机开始穿过厚云层下降。
ex.note: descend into 下降到；descend on 袭击

ex.en: The old man spoke a dialect that few students could understand.
ex.cn: 那位老人说的是一种几乎没几个学生听得懂的方言。
ex.note: in dialect 用方言；the local dialect 当地的方言

ex.en: The college provides special support for students with a disability.
ex.cn: 学院为残疾学生提供特别的支持。
ex.note: with a disability 身有残疾；disability discrimination 残疾人歧视

ex.en: The distance from the campus to the station is about five kilometres.
ex.cn: 从校园到车站大约五公里。
ex.note: in the distance 在远处；keep a distance 保持距离

ex.en: She made a small donation to the village library.
ex.cn: 她向村里的图书馆捐了一小笔钱。
ex.note: make a donation 捐款

ex.en: He drives a truck for a living.
ex.cn: 他靠开卡车为生。
ex.note: drive sb. mad 逼疯某人；drive at 意在

ex.en: They went for a long drive in the countryside.
ex.cn: 他们到乡间长途兜了一圈。
ex.note: go for a drive 去兜风；a driving licence 驾照

ex.en: They dug deep into the earth to look for water.
ex.cn: 他们深挖泥土寻找水源。
ex.note: on earth 世界上；the earth's surface 地表

ex.en: Eighty students sat down to write the final paper.
ex.cn: 八十名学生坐下来写期末考卷。
ex.note: eighty per cent 百分之八十

ex.en: He became emotional when he heard the good news.
ex.cn: 听到这个好消息，他激动得难以自持。
ex.note: emotional support 情感支持；emotional attachment 情感依恋

ex.en: Check the figures twice to ensure that they are correct.
ex.cn: 把数字核对两遍，以确保没有错误。
ex.note: ensure that 确保；ensure sb. sth. 保证某人某事

ex.en: The old farm was left to him as an estate by his uncle.
ex.cn: 那座老农场被叔叔作为遗产留给了他。
ex.note: real estate 房地产；a country estate 乡村庄园

ex.en: Every student must pay the fee, with no exception.
ex.cn: 每名学生都必须缴费，无一例外。
ex.note: with the exception of 除…之外；make an exception for 为…破例

ex.en: Children love to explore the woods behind the school.
ex.cn: 孩子们喜欢到学校后面的林子里探险。
ex.note: explore the possibility 探索可能性

ex.en: The exam was fairly easy, but everyone found the last part hard.
ex.cn: 这场考试相当容易，可每个人都觉得最后一部分难。
ex.note: fairly = 相当（修饰形容词或副词）

ex.en: Long hours of study bring on a kind of mental fatigue.
ex.cn: 长时间学习会带来一种精神上的疲劳。
ex.note: combat fatigue 战斗疲劳；fatigue from … 因…而疲劳

ex.en: They walked across the field towards the old barn.
ex.cn: 他们穿过田野，朝那座旧谷仓走去。
ex.note: a field of study 领域；field research 实地研究

ex.en: The flame under the pan burned blue for a moment.
ex.cn: 锅下的火苗一瞬间烧得发蓝。
ex.note: a flame of anger 一股怒火；flame of fame 名声之火

ex.en: It was foolish to leave the door open all night.
ex.cn: 整夜把门开着是件蠢事。
ex.note: foolish mistake 愚蠢的错误；look foolish 出丑

ex.en: The course gives students a solid foundation in statistics.
ex.cn: 这门课为学生打下统计学的坚实基础。
ex.note: a foundation for … …的基础；foundation course 基础课

ex.en: She likes to fry fish rather than boil it.
ex.cn: 她喜欢把鱼煎着吃，而不是煮着吃。
ex.note: fry sth. in oil 用油煎；fry the eggs 煎蛋

ex.en: The price of gasoline has risen again this year.
ex.cn: 今年汽油价格又上涨了。
ex.note: a gasoline station 加油站

ex.en: He bought a small globe for his son's desk.
ex.cn: 他给儿子的书桌上买了一个小地球仪。
ex.note: a globe 地球仪；across the globe 全世界

ex.en: He will graduate from university in June.
ex.cn: 他将于六月大学毕业。
ex.note: graduate from 从…毕业

ex.en: A graduate student taught the class for a term.
ex.cn: 一位研究生教了这门课一个学期。
ex.note: graduate student 研究生；a college graduate 大学毕业生

ex.en: A study group can make exam season much easier.
ex.cn: 组建一个学习小组能让考试季好过得多。
ex.note: a group of 一群；group discussion 小组讨论

ex.en: The teacher grouped the students into pairs.
ex.cn: 老师把学生分成两人一组。
ex.note: group A into B 把A分成B；group by 按…分组

ex.en: The university sent a handsome thank-you letter to the donor.
ex.cn: 学校给那位捐赠人寄去了一封措辞漂亮的感谢信。
ex.note: a handsome sum of money 一笔可观的款子；a handsome face 英俊的面孔

ex.en: It took a whole week for the quarrel to heal.
ex.cn: 这场争吵花了一整星期才平息。
ex.note: heal over 痊愈；a healing touch 治愈之手

ex.en: "Hi! Are you coming to the study group tonight?" she asked.
ex.cn: “嗨！今晚来学习小组吗？”她问。
ex.note: hi 用于熟人之间，比较随意

ex.en: Winning the scholarship was an honorable achievement.
ex.cn: 赢得这项奖学金是一项光荣的成就。
ex.note: an honorable mention 荣誉提名；honorable discharge 荣誉退役

ex.en: Nearly a hundred people signed the petition.
ex.cn: 差不多有一百人在请愿书上签了字。
ex.note: hundreds of 数百；a hundred percent 百分之百

ex.en: Children with a lively imagination see stories in ordinary objects.
ex.cn: 想象力丰富的孩子能从寻常物件里看出故事。
ex.note: a vivid imagination 丰富的想象力；use one's imagination 发挥想象力

ex.en: Their income has risen since the new factory opened.
ex.cn: 新工厂开工以来，他们的收入涨了。
ex.note: annual income 年收入；income and expenditure 收支

ex.en: She inherited a small farm from her grandmother.
ex.cn: 她从祖母那里继承了一小块农场。
ex.note: inherit sth. from sb. 从某人处继承某物

ex.en: His careless remark was meant as an insult to her.
ex.cn: 他那句随口的话分明是句侮辱。
ex.note: insult sb. 侮辱某人；hurl insults at 向…恶语相向

ex.en: The printing press was one of the great inventions of the century.
ex.cn: 印刷机是那个世纪最伟大的发明之一。
ex.note: a patent invention 专利发明；the invention of … …的发明

ex.en: They jog along the river every Sunday morning.
ex.cn: 每个周日早上他们沿着河慢跑。
ex.note: go jogging 去慢跑；jog sb.'s memory 唤起某人的记忆

ex.en: The village is five kilometers from the nearest station.
ex.cn: 这个村子离最近的车站五公里。
ex.note: a ten-kilometer run 十公里长跑

ex.en: Language is the hardest subject for him, but he enjoys it.
ex.cn: 语言对他来说是最难的一科，但他乐在其中。
ex.note: a foreign language 外语；in plain language 通俗地说

ex.en: The deer took a leap and cleared the low fence.
ex.cn: 那头鹿轻轻一跃，跳过了那道矮篱笆。
ex.note: by leaps and bounds 突飞猛进；a leap in the dark 盲目冒险

ex.en: She lifted the lid of the pot to let the steam out.
ex.cn: 她揭开锅盖，让蒸汽散出去。
ex.note: the lid of a box 箱盖；eye lid 眼睑

ex.en: He carried a heavy load of books up the stairs.
ex.cn: 他抱着一大摞书爬上了楼梯。
ex.note: a heavy load 重担；loads of 大量

ex.en: They loaded the van with boxes of old notes.
ex.cn: 他们把一箱箱旧笔记装上了货车。
ex.note: load sth. into sth. 把…装进…；be loaded with 充满

ex.en: The company rewarded his loyalty with a small gift.
ex.cn: 公司用一份小礼物回报了他的忠诚。
ex.note: loyalty to 对…的忠诚；test sb.'s loyalty 考验某人的忠诚

ex.en: He managed to finish the report before the deadline.
ex.cn: 他设法在截止日期前写完了报告。
ex.note: manage to do 设法做成；manage without 不用…也应付得来

ex.en: The final examinations are in May, and the term ends in June.
ex.cn: 期末考试在五月，学期到六月结束。
ex.note: in May 在五月；the May of … …的五月

ex.en: The menu was written on a small board by the door.
ex.cn: 菜单写在门边的一块小木板上。
ex.note: on the menu 在菜单上；a full menu 品种齐全的菜

ex.en: There was only a minor error in the last line.
ex.cn: 最后一行只有一个小的错误。
ex.note: a minor role 次要角色；minor damage 轻微损坏

ex.en: He took engineering as his major and history as his minor.
ex.cn: 他主修工程，辅修历史。
ex.note: a minor in … …的辅修科目；declare a minor 申报辅修

ex.en: The term began in September and lasted for six months.
ex.cn: 学期从九月开始，持续了六个月。
ex.note: in a month 一个月后；month by month 一个月一个月地

ex.en: You multiply six by eight to get forty-eight.
ex.cn: 把六乘以八，就得四十八。
ex.note: multiply A by B 把A乘以B；multiply rapidly 迅速增加

ex.en: The train was nearly an hour late.
ex.cn: 火车晚点了将近一个小时。
ex.note: nearly = 几乎；not nearly 远非

ex.en: Most of the reading in the library is done at night.
ex.cn: 图书馆里大部分阅读都是在夜里完成的。
ex.note: at night 在夜里；night after night 一夜又一夜

ex.en: A noun names a person, a place or a thing.
ex.cn: 名词指人、地点或事物。
ex.note: a countable noun 可数名词；a common noun 普通名词

ex.en: The students occupied every seat in the reading room.
ex.cn: 学生们占满了阅览室的每一个座位。
ex.note: be occupied with 忙于；occupy oneself with 从事

ex.en: An Italian opera was playing softly on the radio.
ex.cn: 收音机里轻轻播放着一出意大利歌剧。
ex.note: a grand opera 大歌剧；opera house 歌剧院

ex.en: Our plan is simple: we review one subject every evening.
ex.cn: 我们的计划很简单：每晚复习一门科目。
ex.note: our own 我们自己的；for our sake 为了我们

ex.en: Trees release oxygen into the air and take in carbon dioxide.
ex.cn: 树木向空气中释放氧气，吸收二氧化碳。
ex.note: oxygen supply 氧气供应；oxygen mask 氧气面罩

ex.en: He played an important part in the whole performance.
ex.cn: 他在整场演出中扮演了重要角色。
ex.note: take part in 参加；a part of … …的一部分

ex.en: The two friends parted at the gate.
ex.cn: 两个朋友在门口分开了。
ex.note: part from sb. 与某人分离；part company with 与…绝交

ex.en: The valley was quiet and peaceful in the early morning.
ex.cn: 清晨的山谷安静而平和。
ex.note: a peaceful settlement 和平解决；peaceful coexistence 和平共处

ex.en: He treated the failure as a personal matter and told nobody.
ex.cn: 他把这次失利看作私人的事，没告诉任何人。
ex.note: personal opinion 个人意见；personal belongings 个人物品

ex.en: He took a pill for his headache and lay down for a while.
ex.cn: 他吃了一片止痛的药，躺下休息了一会儿。
ex.note: a sleeping pill 安眠药；take a pill 服药

ex.en: He put the plug in the socket and switched on the lamp.
ex.cn: 他把插头插进插座，打开了台灯。
ex.note: power plug 电源插头；plug socket 插座

ex.en: The teacher plugged in a computer for the lesson.
ex.cn: 老师接上了一台电脑来上课。
ex.note: plug in 插上（电源）；plug up 堵住

ex.en: She was waiting for him on the porch of the old house.
ex.cn: 她在老屋的门廊上等他。
ex.note: front porch 前廊；the house porch 门廊

ex.en: He had practically finished the book when the bell rang.
ex.cn: 铃响的时候，他差不多已经看完了那本书。
ex.note: practically speaking 实际上；practically impossible 几乎不可能

ex.en: He felt a deep pride in his father's words.
ex.cn: 父亲的话让他感到深深的自豪。
ex.note: take pride in 为…自豪；pride and joy 自豪与喜悦

ex.en: She prides herself on never missing a deadline.
ex.cn: 她为自己从未误过期限而自豪。
ex.note: pride oneself on 以…自豪

ex.en: The professor of chemistry explained the rule twice.
ex.cn: 化学教授把那条规则解释了两遍。
ex.note: a professor of … …的教授；professor emeritus 荣休教授

ex.en: The library keeps a provision of spare chairs in the basement.
ex.cn: 图书馆在地下室备着一些备用椅子。
ex.note: make provision for 为…做准备；a special provision 特别条款

ex.en: A quarter of the students work in the evening.
ex.cn: 四分之一的学生在晚上学习。
ex.note: a quarter past … 过…刻；the first quarter 第一季度

ex.en: The pass rate at the university is over ninety per cent.
ex.cn: 这所大学的及格率超过百分之九十。
ex.note: at the rate of 以…的速度；the exchange rate 汇率

ex.en: The professor rated the work highly.
ex.cn: 教授给这份作业很高的评价。
ex.note: rate sb. highly 高度评价某人

ex.en: He received a small smile of recognition from the coach.
ex.cn: 教练朝他露出一个赞许的微笑。
ex.note: in recognition of 表彰；gain recognition 获得认可

ex.en: A regular routine is more useful than long hours of worry.
ex.cn: 固定规律的作息比长时间的焦虑更有用。
ex.note: regular hours 固定时间；regular customer 老顾客

ex.en: The rent of the flat is due at the end of the month.
ex.cn: 这套公寓的房租月底到期。
ex.note: pay the rent 交房租；a rent increase 租金上涨

ex.en: They rented a small house near the campus for the summer.
ex.cn: 他们为夏天在校门附近租了一间小屋。
ex.note: rent sth. from sb. 从某人处租用；rent out 出租

ex.en: Old exam papers are a useful resource for new students.
ex.cn: 旧试卷对新生来说是一份有用的资料。
ex.note: natural resources 自然资源；a valuable resource 宝贵资源

ex.en: It is not easy to get rid of old habits.
ex.cn: 摆脱旧习惯并不容易。
ex.note: get rid of 摆脱；rid sb. of sth. 使某人摆脱某事

ex.en: The milk smells sour and the bread has gone rotten.
ex.cn: 牛奶闻起来发酸，面包已经烂了。
ex.note: go rotten 变质腐烂；rotten with 充满

ex.en: She made a tomato salad with olive oil and salt.
ex.cn: 她做了一份番茄沙拉，淋上橄榄油，撒了点盐。
ex.note: green salad 蔬菜沙拉；salad bowl 沙拉碗

ex.en: From the top of the hill the whole valley was one beautiful scene.
ex.cn: 从山顶望去，整个山谷是一幅美丽的景象。
ex.note: the scene of a novel 小说的场景；a scene of crime 案发现场

ex.en: The first section of the paper explains the theory.
ex.cn: 试卷的第一部分解释了那个理论。
ex.note: a cross section 横截面；the sports section 体育版

ex.en: The service in the dining hall has improved a lot this year.
ex.cn: 今年食堂的服务改善了不少。
ex.note: service station 服务站；out of service 停用

ex.en: The wind shifted in the afternoon and the fog began to clear.
ex.cn: 下午风向变了，雾开始消散。
ex.note: shift sth. to 把…转移到；shift responsibility 推卸责任

ex.en: She works the night shift at the library.
ex.cn: 她在图书馆上夜班。
ex.note: night shift 夜班；work shifts 轮班

ex.en: The professor raised his hand as a signal to begin.
ex.cn: 教授抬手示意开始。
ex.note: a clear signal 明确的信号；signal lamp 信号灯

ex.en: He signalled to the driver to pull over.
ex.cn: 他示意司机靠边停车。
ex.note: signal sb. to do 示意某人做；signal that 表明

ex.en: Here is a rough sketch of how the course is organized.
ex.cn: 这是这门课程组织方式的一个粗略说明。
ex.note: a rough sketch of … …的粗略概述；a sketch of 素描

ex.en: She sketched the plan on the back of an old envelope.
ex.cn: 她在旧信封背面画了张草图。
ex.note: sketch out 勾勒出

ex.en: A snake moved slowly across the path and slipped into the grass.
ex.cn: 一条蛇慢慢爬过小路，钻进了草丛。
ex.note: a snake in the grass 草丛中的蛇；snake oil 江湖郎中的油

ex.en: The result was somewhat surprising to everyone.
ex.cn: 这个结果让每个人都有些意外。
ex.note: somewhat more 稍微更多；somewhat of a 算得上是

ex.en: Could you give me a specific example of that rule?
ex.cn: 你能就那条规则给我举个具体的例子吗？
ex.note: be specific about 对…具体说明；specific to 特定的

ex.en: He spread the map out on the table and traced the route.
ex.cn: 他把地图摊在桌上，沿着路线比划。
ex.note: spread sth. out 摊开；spread a rumour 散布谣言

ex.en: The spread of the disease was stopped in time.
ex.cn: 这种病的蔓延及时被控制住了。
ex.note: the spread of … …的蔓延；a spread of butter 涂上的一层黄油

ex.en: Steam rose from the soup and fogged up the window.
ex.cn: 热气从汤里升起来，弄得窗户蒙了一层雾。
ex.note: steam engine 蒸汽机；by steam 乘轮船

ex.en: She steamed the vegetables for five minutes.
ex.cn: 她把蔬菜蒸了五分钟。
ex.note: steam sth. 把…蒸熟；be steaming with excitement 激动不已

ex.en: The best strategy for the exam is to start early and review often.
ex.cn: 应付考试最好的策略是早点开始、经常复习。
ex.note: a winning strategy 制胜策略；adopt a strategy 采取策略

ex.en: Subtract the smaller number from the larger one.
ex.cn: 用大数减去小数。
ex.note: subtract A from B 用B减A

ex.en: The new library is a super place for quiet study.
ex.cn: 新图书馆是个特别适合安静自习的地方。
ex.note: super = 极好的（口语）；superb 更好的

ex.en: They were asked to sweep the floor after the lecture.
ex.cn: 讲座结束后，他们被要求把地扫了。
ex.note: sweep the floor 扫地；sweep sth. under the carpet 掩盖

ex.en: The soup had a strong taste of garlic.
ex.cn: 那汤有一股浓浓的蒜味。
ex.note: a good taste 品味好；taste in art 艺术鉴赏力

ex.en: He tasted the soup and asked for more.
ex.cn: 他尝了尝汤，又要了一份。
ex.note: taste of 有…的味道；taste for 品味

ex.en: They put up a tent beside the stream and spent the night there.
ex.cn: 他们在溪边支起帐篷，在那里过了一夜。
ex.note: put up a tent 搭帐篷；a circus tent 马戏团帐篷

ex.en: They studied all evening and left just before the library closed.
ex.cn: 他们整个晚上都在学习，就在图书馆关门前不久才离开。
ex.note: they say 据说；they're = they are

ex.en: The reading room is closed on Thursday afternoon.
ex.cn: 阅览室周四下午不开放。
ex.note: on Thursday 在周四；Thursday evening 周四晚上

ex.en: She cut the tomato into thin slices.
ex.cn: 她把西红柿切成了薄片。
ex.note: tomato soup 番茄汤；cherry tomato 小番茄

ex.en: They followed a narrow trail up the side of the hill.
ex.cn: 他们沿着一条狭窄的小路往山坡上走。
ex.note: a mountain trail 山间小径；leave no trail 不留痕迹

ex.en: The police trailed the suspect to an old warehouse.
ex.cn: 警方跟踪嫌犯来到一座旧仓库。
ex.note: trail sb. 跟踪某人；trail behind 落在后面

ex.en: The team walked off the field in triumph.
ex.cn: 队伍凯旋般地走下了场地。
ex.note: in triumph 凯旋地；a triumph over 对…的胜利

ex.en: They triumphed over every obstacle that winter.
ex.cn: 那个冬天，他们战胜了所有的障碍。
ex.note: triumph over 战胜；triumph in 在…方面获胜

ex.en: The building was ugly, but the view from it was wonderful.
ex.cn: 那座楼很难看，但从那里望出去的风景却极好。
ex.note: an ugly mood 糟糕的心情；ugly duckling 丑小鸭

ex.en: Unlike his brother, he enjoys reading aloud to other people.
ex.cn: 和他哥哥不同，他喜欢大声朗读给别人听。
ex.note: unlike prep. 与…不同（前面用逗号）；be unlike sb. 不像某人

ex.en: His answer was vague, so they changed the subject.
ex.cn: 他的回答含糊其辞，于是他们换了话题。
ex.note: a vague idea 模糊的想法；vague about 对…含糊

ex.en: From a parent's viewpoint, the change is easy to understand.
ex.cn: 从家长的角度看，这个变化不难理解。
ex.note: from the viewpoint of 从…的角度；a broad viewpoint 宽阔的视野

ex.en: The voyage across the bay took half an hour.
ex.cn: 横渡海湾的航程花了半个小时。
ex.note: a long voyage 长途航行；the voyage of life 人生之旅

ex.en: They voyaged down the coast for two weeks.
ex.cn: 他们沿着海岸航行了两个星期。
ex.note: voyage through 穿越

ex.en: A sharp tongue can be a dangerous weapon.
ex.cn: 锋利的舌头可能是一件危险的武器。
ex.note: a weapon against 对付…的手段；be a weapon of 是…的武器

ex.en: This is the room where we met for the first time.
ex.cn: 这就是我们第一次见面的那个房间。
ex.note: where = 在哪里/在那里；that's where 那就是…的地方

ex.en: They ordered a bottle of red wine with the meal.
ex.cn: 他们点了一瓶红葡萄酒佐餐。
ex.note: a glass of wine 一杯葡萄酒；a wine cellar 酒窖

ex.en: The second exam was worse than the first.
ex.cn: 第二次考试比第一次更糟。
ex.note: worse and worse 越来越糟；no worse 并不更差

ex.en: Most of the youngsters in the class come from small towns.
ex.cn: 班里大多数年轻人来自小镇。
ex.note: a local youngster 本地的年轻人
